In addition, the increase in private registries has also increased the performance and capacity requirements of the image storage system. Because there are a large number of redundant data and redundant files in the image file, using its high redundancy to reduce duplicate data can greatly reduce the ever-increasing registry storage requirements. Based on the characteristics of virtual machine images and container images, this paper proposes and designs a high-efficiency storage system for virtualized resource images given the large volume of virtualized resource images and high storage occupation. Through this system, the utilization rate of image storage can be improved and reduced the cost of store images.

articleTitle: Design of household gas emergency solution based on earthquake early warning and intelligent gateway
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: At present, the national earthquake intensity quick report and early warning project is in the full implementation stage. In Fujian, the earthquake early warning information can be provided to the public through mobile app and specific terminals. But there is also a lack of effective solutions to use the early warning information to reduce personal and property losses for the majority of family users. Earthquake emergency disposal is the key technology to use the earthquake early warning information to solve the problem in last 1km. The intelligent gateway receives the earthquake early warning information through the message middleware, and processes to evaluate the safety of earthquake gas, then judges whether to start the gas earthquake emergency disposal system. The intelligent gateway communicates with the server through WiFi. and communicates with gas earthquake emergency disposal system through ZigBee wireless communication technologies, and realizes the automatic shutdown of gas when destructive earthquake occurrence. The system can prevent the occurrence of gas accidents in destructive earthquakes, make full use of earthquake early warning information, realize the home application of earthquake early warning information, and reduce casualties and economic losses caused by earthquakes.

articleTitle: Design of Human-computer Interaction System Using Gesture Recognition Algorithm from the Perspective of Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The human-computer interaction (HCI) system is the hub of conversation between man and machine. The previous HCI system is challenging to meet the needs of modern society with the continuous progress of computer technology. A new HCI technology different from the past needs to be put forward to solve the problem that the development of computer technology and outdated HCI technology lag behind the times. Machine learning aims to build a behavior method that can obtain information from data and predict the data. Machine learning features are used and integrated into gesture algorithms through the basic principle of a finger-guessing game. Gesture estimation is adopted to detect joint gesture features efficiently, and a convolutional neural network is employed to plan and process the joint features to solve the bottleneck of poor segmentation of gesture images in different environments. HCI system based on gesture recognition algorithm is designed from the perspective of machine learning. The final experimental results show that this method has good recognition accuracy for the performance of different scales of various gestures, and the accuracy of recognition results can reach 70%. It suggests that the system is theoretically conditional on making the recognition result reach the most authentic level. It is demonstrated that gesture recognition is of excellent use value in this HCI system, and the HCI system established here also has an efficient reference value.

articleTitle: Bluetooth indoor positioning combination algorithm based on fingerprint matching technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: There are two problems with fingerprint matching indoor positioning technology based on Bluetooth Low Energy; in the process of collecting Bluetooth signals, due to the shadow effect and multipath effect, the signal is prone to violent fluctuations, abnormal values and special values, and Kalman filtering is commonly used only for Linear systems, for one-dimensional non-linear Bluetooth signals, are prone to data dispersion, causing positioning errors. The commonly used k-means clustering algorithm in the region division stage requires the number of clusters and the value of k to be specified in advance, which is more sensitive to the initial value and cannot determine the number of reference points according to the positioning environment. Based on the above problems, the extended Kalman filter (EKF) optimization database is first proposed. The nonlinear system adopts local Taylor expansion to form a linear system, and the problem of Kalman filter's sensitivity to nonlinear data is solved by the regression iteration method. The multi-dimensional similarity propagation clustering algorithm (MAP) is proposed, and the Pearson correlation coefficient dimension based on RSSI is proposed to redefine the similarity matrix elements. The results show that the fingerprint database of the proposed combination algorithm is optimized, the reference point area is more detailed, the algorithm adaptability is higher, and the average positioning accuracy is improved.

articleTitle: Style Transfer Analysis Based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Style transfer means using a neural network to extract the content of one image and the style of the other image. The two are combined to get the final result, broadly applied in social communication, animation production, entertainment items. Using style transfer, users can share and exchange images; painters can create specific art styles more readily with less creation cost and production time. Therefore, style transfer is widely concerned recently due to its various and valuable applications. In the past few years, the paper reviews style transfer and chooses three representative works to analyze in detail and contrast with each other, including StyleGAN, CycleGAN, and TL-GAN. Moreover, what function an ideal model of style transfer should realize is discussed. Compared with such a model, potential problems and prospects of different methods to achieve style transfer are listed. A couple of solutions to these drawbacks are given in the end.

articleTitle: Memory Augmented Variational Auto-Encoder for Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Anomaly detection is of great importance due to its wide application in industrial areas. Deep auto-encoders have enabled significant advances in anomaly detection over the past decade. However, it has been observed that sometimes the auto-encoder are likely to reconstruct anomalies due to the “excellent” generalization ability, resulting in the miss detection of anomalies. To mitigate this deficiency, scholars have proposed the memory-augmented deep auto-encoder method recently. However, more recent work on memory-augmented uses continuous memory representations or key-values pairs in memory for read/write without forgetting mechanism, and it is assumed that data such as early access to the network are normal data. To deal with those imperfectness, we present a VAE-based memory-augmented network with a trained memory network: MEMVAE, addressing scheme to provide a strong guarantee to detect anomalous. In particular, Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) cells are employed as the encoder and decoder to capture latent temporal structure. We then train an external memory module that records common patterns of the prototype. In addition, we present a weighted regular score that simply updates our memory entries. Our detector reports a reconstruction probability as the anomaly score. Experimental results on tabular data and time series data show that MEMVAE demonstrates significant improvements and better performance.

articleTitle: Research on MDS and Semi-supervised Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology, the dimensions of data have exploded, and many data analyses have become very difficult. To solve the above problems, the use of dimension reduction method of the multidimensional scaling transformation (MDS) for data dimension reduction, get rid of some redundant information, save the storage space. In view of the traditional k-means clustering method, by introducing a pair constraint supervision information to guide the clustering process, formed a semi-supervised k means clustering approach. In addition, on the basis of the Cop-Kmeans algorithm based on Breadth-first search (BFS), I design an improvement based on data segmentation technology in terms of the selection of the initial clustering center. In this paper, MDS and the improved <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{BFS}+\text{Cop}$</tex>-Kmeans algorithm are fused to form the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{MDS}+\text{BCK}$</tex> algorithm, and on the UCI data set an experimental verification was performed. The first results of the test indicate that the performance of the present algorithm shows further improvements compared to the traditional k-mean algorithm, the Cop-Kmean means, and the unimproved <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{BFS}\ +\ \text{Cop}$</tex> - Kmean algorithm.

articleTitle: The Trend of Research on Alzheimer's Disease based on Bibliometrics and Visualization using Echarts
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To reveal the trend of research on Alzheimer's disease (AD) in recent years, and to analyze and analyze the time, country, author, periodical and research hotspots of AD related literatures, and visualize them. And compared the differences in research between China, the United States and other countries in the world so as to provide help for researchers and clinicians. This study selected PMC and PubMed databases of national Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) in the United States, and searched 120,000 related literatures by using the keyword Alzheimer's disease. Based on the bibliometrics method, this paper adopts Python script to conduct statistical analysis of the retrieved literature. Moreover, this paper mainly analyzes literatures from 1996 to 2015, and uses Echarts tool for visual processing.

articleTitle: Explore a New Category Normalized Indicator in the Context of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Category normalized indicators within a short time window are unreliable for scientific research evaluation. To solve this problem. Wang and Zhang proposed a new normalized indicator called WCNCI (Weighted Category Normalized Citation Impact), which reflects the reliability of a paper's standard score by introducing a weighting factor, where the longer (shorter) the publication time of a paper, the greater (smaller) the weight. Because this indicator assigns a large weight to older papers with longer publication time and to disciplines such as biology and medicine that are prone to high citations, the fairness of the evaluation results is biased. Thus, in this study, an improved normalized indicator called the NWCNCI (New WCNCI) is proposed. The values and rankings of each university under different normalized indicators, that is CNCI, WCNCI, and NWCNCI were calculated separately using Java on a sample of the top 500 universities in the world of ARWU2020, and correlation analysis and research were performed. The result demonstrated that the NWCNCI values and rankings of the 500 universities were highly correlated with the CNCI and WCNCI values and rankings, however, simultaneously, some universities still had a large variation in their values and rankings. Thus, it is concluded that the NWCNCI normalized indicator provides a solution to the problem of standardization and is the ideal tool for evaluating research output.

articleTitle: Research on error compensation method for 10kV 1kA high accuracy current measuring device
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this paper, a high-voltage current measuring device with shielding is designed and developed. Its electrotechnical error compensation and active error compensation are carried out to meet the accuracy level of 0.01 under low voltage. A capacitive leakage error test method is proposed. Theory and experiment verify the consistency and effectiveness of the proposed reference phase-locked method and the applied voltage-current method. The error analysis method of the high-voltage current measuring device is presented. Through error synthesis, the error analysis of the high voltage current measuring device is completed, proving that it meets the requirements of the error limit under high voltage. The effectiveness of error compensation in this paper is verified by studying the current measuring device and its error analysis technology.

articleTitle: Generating Music with Generative Adversarial Networks and Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Music exerts an essential role in human beings' daily life. However, there are many restrictions in the field of traditional music creation. In recent years, with the development of artificial intelligence accelerated significantly, how to apply deep learning to music creation is an intriguing topic, and it is worth a wide range of exploration and discussions. In the paper, a deep learning model composed of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) was introduced to implement the generation of music. The GANs are mainly composed of a generator and a discriminator, while LSTM serves as the basic unit of the generator and discriminator. Through analyzing the music file generated in different iteration times, the results demonstrate that the pieces of music we got via the model made up of GAN and LSTM are in a similar pattern.

articleTitle: A Rank-Based Sampling Framework For Offline Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) is an attractive method that learns a policy purely from a previously collected dataset without additional interaction. However, it suffers the data quality issue that the performance of the policy is largely dependent on the previously collected dataset. In this paper, we propose a novel and robust sampling technique, Rank-Based sampling (RBS) to address this issue for offline RL. This method samples the transition with high return more frequently and reduces the influence of outliers. In this way, each transition has attached a rank of importance for non-uniform sampling. RBS approximates the optimal value of each state in offline dataset through the upper envelope neural network. Our method is compatible with many existing offline RL methods, e.g. Batch-Constrained deep Q-learning (BCQ), a hyperparameter-robust offline RL algorithm. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive experimental study in simulation environments. BCQ with RBS achieves a new state-of-the-art of performance, outperforming vanilla BCQ with uniform sampling and two other algorithms.

articleTitle: A multi-criteria decision method for interval values by improved score function under evidence theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Traditional Interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy sets (IVIFS) face the problems of easy missing of fusion information, information loss, and difficulty of fusion when expressing attribute hesitancy properties. To this end, we propose an interval BPA decision method based on Golden Rule representative value, which uses the representation attribute values of intuitionistic fuzzy sets, converts interval intuitionistic fuzzy numbers into interval BPAs and uses Golden Rule representative values to modify the score function with risk values for decision making. Experiments demonstrate that the method improves the effectiveness of information fusion and can be easily extended to other applications of IVIFS.

articleTitle: Active Detection Technology of 3-Dimension Artificial Intelligence Robot Based on Visual Positioning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Camera repositioning is a key module in SLAM system, which is of great significance to ensure the robustness of positioning and mapping of mobile robots in complex scenes, and is also one of the core technologies of augmented reality and automatic driving. In order to improve the active detection and spatial positioning ability of 3D artificial intelligence robot with self-adaptive posture, an active detection and spatial positioning method of 3D artificial intelligence robot with self-adaptive posture based on visual positioning and Monte Carlo estimation is proposed. The method comprises the following steps of: constructing a dynamic environment characteristic heat map ray projection recognition model of the posture self-adaptive 3D artificial intelligence robot, collecting scene data in the process of edge characteristic detection of the movement track of the posture self-adaptive 3D artificial intelligence robot by adopting a characteristic heat map ray projection method, and establishing a Monte Carlo parameter estimation model for global positioning detection of the movement track distribution of the posture self-adaptive 3D artificial intelligence robot; Based on visual positioning and Monte Carlo parameter estimation method, the edge feature detection and active detection parameter positioning of 3D artificial intelligence robot with self-adaptive posture adjustment are realized. Through 3D visual positioning and maximum likelihood estimation parameter identification, the motion space planning and active detection of 3D artificial intelligence robot with self-adaptive posture adjustment are realized. Combined with visual SLAM method, the active detection model of 3D artificial intelligence robot is constructed to improve the control stability. Tests show that this method has good adaptability in active detection and spatial positioning of 3D artificial intelligence robot, and has strong obstacle avoidance ability.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent calculation method of theoretical line loss in station area
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved k-means algorithm to optimize the original clustering center points. Firstly, the common clustering analysis algorithms are introduced; Then, the k-means algorithm for optimizing the selection of original clustering center pointss is introduced, and the classification of station samples using this method is carried out; Finally, the comparison of contour coefficients verifies the effectiveness of the algorithm in station classification

articleTitle: Research on Model of Passive Bearing-Crossing Location
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Passive crossing location is widely used in reconnaissance location without positive electromagnetic radiation. For passive crossing location, the existed model is built on the hypothesis that the direction-finding errors are all the same for the direction-finding stations, and then intersection point, fuzzy area and error probability are studied and analyzed. According to the signal-to-noise (SNR) performance of the direction-finding antenna employed by bearing-crossing direction-finding station, the SNR of one direction-finding antenna can be estimated by the SNR of the other direction-finding antenna and relative position of unknown emitter, and finally direction-finding errors can be calculated. In this paper, model of passive bearing-crossing location is studied, relative position between unknown emitter and direction-finding stations and SNR performance of direction-finding antenna are studied, and meanwhile simulations are conducted. Simulation results showed that the distances between signal source and direction-findings will influence SNRs received by antenna of direction-findings, and will result in different RMSE of direction-finding results. This work will contribute to further study of more accurate and efficient cross location method.

articleTitle: Research on Data acquisition technology of COVID-19 information Based on SCRAPY_REDIS
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The novel coronavirus pneumonia has been spreading in China and worldwide. People have been paying close attention to the epidemic situation through the Internet. It is of great practical significance to obtain public opinion information and supervise the epidemic situation from the Internet. In this context, the improved SCRAPY_Redis framework and cluster technology are used to crawl epidemic data, analyze and filter epidemic sensitive words, and realize visualization through numpy, panda, Matplotlib and wordcloud. After experimental analysis and running test, the improved framework is proved to be more effective than the traditional scrapy framework in speed and performance, with stable performance and good operation.

articleTitle: Study on Multi-energy Complementary Model of Coupling System of Distribution Network and Heat Pump Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the continuous integration of cold, heat, electricity and other energy systems and the market-oriented reform of energy transactions, the traditional power demand response can no longer meet the business needs of multi-energy coupling. Distribution network and heat pump energy storage coupled cooling and heating system is a combination of renewable energy utilization and energy storage technology, which is beneficial to improve the utilization rate of renewable energy. At the same time, by shifting peaks and filling valleys, the operating cost of the system can be reduced and the balanced dispatching of the power grid can be realized. In this paper, an electro-thermal complementary model of coupled heating and cooling system with energy storage of distribution network and heat pump is proposed, and through simulation analysis of an example, it is verified that the proposed method can effectively improve the flexibility of energy supply and operation economy of the system.

articleTitle: Parameter Optimized Intelligent Algorithm for Consumer Psychology of Web Red Milk Tea Purchases
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the continuous progress and development of Internet and information technology, online milk tea has gradually entered the public eye. The consumers' consumption psychology in online milk tea consumption decision-making is widely valued by practitioners in milk tea industry. How to effectively analyze consumers' psychological decision-making process has become the main topic at present. Taking Fuzhou City as an example, this study uses IBM SPSS20.0 software to test the reliability and validity of the questionnaire. Seven explanatory variables and one target variable were determined by principal component analysis (PCA). Four algorithms, decision tree (DT), random forest (RF), support vector machine (SVM) and k-nearest neighbor (KNN), were used to establish the relationship between target variables and explanatory variables, and the consumer psychology of online milk tea was analyzed. Intelligent algorithm is used to combine simulated annealing (SA) algorithm with SVM to realize automatic parameter adjustment and improve classification accuracy. The experimental results show that the decision tree obtains six decision rules that affect consumers' psychology of buying online milk tea, which can be used as an important decision to judge whether consumers agree to buy online milk tea, and help the milk tea industry to establish a better foothold and provide valuable reference.

articleTitle: A Lung Nodule Detector Based on U-Net and 3D-CNN Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Lungs of people are susceptible to developing cancer; according to WHO, cancer is a leading cause of death worldwide, accounting for nearly 10 million deaths in 2020, and lung cancer alone has caused 1.8 million deaths. To tackle the lung cancer, this paper proposes a 3D U-Net model, which can be utilized to diagnose cancer on CT scans. In the preprocessing step, it converts lung nodule CT scans in DICOM format to PNG format for the purpose of training the model. After that, this study employs 3-dimensional U-Net model, segmentation algorithm, to detect all possible areas of lung nodules on the CT scan. Since lung nodules might be misclassified, this paper introduces a convolutional neural network to classify real and fake lung nodules. The experimental results demonstrate that ACC reached 93.8%. Furthermore, it has been noted that AUC has 0.9358, which means the model has good classification ability for positive and negative cases.

articleTitle: Application of 3D Remote Sensing Technology in Aided Design of Low Altitude Magnetic Survey Flight
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Using remote sensing technology, GIS technology and virtual reality technology, the remote sensing image and DEM data are superimposed to establish a three-dimensional remote sensing image model of the low-altitude magnetic survey flight work area. The three-dimensional model can clearly reflect the distribution of surface vegetation, rivers, wetlands and other ground features with topographical features, and can design flight routes based on survey lines to achieve simulated flight and generate three-dimensional animations. In the preparatory stage of flight work, simulated flight animation can visually display terrain undulations and surface coverage to technical personnel, guide the deployment of flight work, and provide decision support for large-scale low-altitude aeromagnetic surveys.

articleTitle: An extended QUALIFLEX method combined hesitant fuzzy linguistic term sets with prospect theory for medical waste disposal method selection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In the existing research, several multiple criteria decisions making (MCDM) methods have been proposed to choose the treatment method of medical waste. However, these issues are partially or completely need to be resolved: (1) the hesitation behavior of experts in the process of decision-making evaluation; (2) the psychological behavior of decision-makers; (3) the comparison or micro comparison between the same attributes of different alternatives, yet the qualitative flexible multiple criteria method (QUALIFLEX) has the unique advantage of dealing with the comparison between criteria, and which is selected. Therefore, an extended QUALIFLEX combined the hesitant fuzzy linguistic term sets (HFLTS) with prospect theory for the selection of medical waste disposal methods.

articleTitle: Improved Collaborative Filtering Integrated with Diverse Optimization Strategies
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this paper, an Improved Collaborative Filtering Integrated with Diverse Optimization Strategies (ICFIDOS) is proposed to improve the performance of recommendation system. First, data sparsity problem of collaborative filtering was relieved via Slope One algorithm. Then, Hybrid Shilling Attacks Detection Framework is utilized to help recommendation system to defend the traditional and modern Shilling Attacks, and purify the polluted data. After that, cold start problem of initial trusted degree was resolved via combination with the influence of new users and existed users. Furthermore, similarity computation of Item Preference is improved. Finally, every step of our ICFIDOS algorithm was clarified carefully. In experiment, the efficiency of ICFIDOS is validated and has better performance compared to classical UBCF and K_TUBCF algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of VR Technology in Treating Autism
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder is a complex developmental disorder that will impact communication, social interaction, and behavioral regulation. Meanwhile, the incidence is increasing globally in recent years, and the exact cure for ASD still does not exist. However, the application of Virtual Reality technology in treating autism spectrum disorder shows promising potential. This passage analyzes the qualities of authenticity, immersion, and interactivity brought by VR and explores the way how it increases the trainer's probability of transforming their scenaior's experience and the skills they have developed into an actual situation in daily life, making the therapy effective, practical, and credible assessment possible. By examining the effect of VR treatment from the practical example and designing a VR scenario, the results show that VR greatly enhances the effectiveness and application potential of behavioral corrections and other symptoms.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for COVID-19 Lung CT Scans Classification Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: COVID-19 disease has been taking away millions of lives from the earth since 2020. Thousands of people have lost their lives because of the shortage of limited medical resources. To tackle this urgent issue, this paper proposed a CNN classification model based on application to help a patient determine if COVID-19 infects lung CT scan of the patient. The application contains a user interface based on the Flask framework, combined with a trained CNN model, which will proceed with the CT scan uploaded by the patient and inform the patient of the result. Additionally, the application simulates a personal virtual assistant, which can be utilized to answer patients' queries. The personal virtual assistant, also known as a chatbot, is made with Natural Language Processing (NLP), which will transfer the patient's input into tokens and return the most likely response to the patient. Unfortunately, after constructing the CNN model, the prediction was not highly accurate. The experimental result demonstrated that the loss value is generally decreasing throughout the training process, and the accuracy score is generally increasing. However, the overall performance was not smooth, which means the model was unstable. The reason that causes this problem is the shortage of the training dataset.

articleTitle: A Structure Analysis Method of Radar Emitter Relation Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The various detection scenes of radar emitter lead to the swallowing of radar features and low identification accuracy of radar individual targets, which makes it very difficult for the system to associate targets automatically. To solve the above problems, the adaptive ability of target identification and association can be improved by building radar emitter relation network. In this paper, based on the radar emitter relation network, the structure of the radar emitter relation network is analyzed by using the community detection method, which is one of many complex network structure analysis method, aiming at radar emitter relation network's characteristics of the complex network. The experiment results show that the method is effective in analyzing the structure of emitter relation network.

articleTitle: Design of Missile Electrical System in High Power Microwave Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: During the flight of guided missiles, it is susceptible to the influence of high power microwave irradiation, which will generate inductive electric field and affect the signal transmission inside the missiles. In this paper, CST software is used to establish the missile model and electrical model inside the missile, and the influence of electrical design on its microwave effect characteristics is studied. The simulation results show that the interference of high-power microwave on missile electrical signal transmission can be effectively suppressed by using shielded twisted pair, adding filter circuit and reducing the gap width between cabin sections. According to the results of simulation analysis, it provides guidance for the design of missiles electrical system in high-power microwave environment.

articleTitle: Temporal Movement Prediction Based on Tweet Texts and Historical Price via Adversarial Training
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Temporal movement prediction is essential to finance and investing. The early works for stock movement prediction are mainly based on traditional machine learning algorithms. They have achieved good results, while these conventional machine learning methods require costly hand-craft engineering for massive features. Recently, the prevalence of deep learning has effectively promoted the ability to solve stock movement prediction, which has been widely studied in academia and industrial fields. Although deep-learning-based methods have achieved certain progress, there are two problems limiting performance improvement for the temporal movement prediction task. Firstly, current procedures mainly apply temporal factors like trading volume, market value, etc. They may ignore the influence of news and temporal sentiment information on temporal movement. Secondly, even if there exist researches of temporal movement prediction based on financial news and temporal sentiments, those methods would be probably overfitting. Thirdly, they are vulnerable to inherent stochasticity (e.g. black swan events) in the temporal scenario. To address these problems, this paper puts forward a temporal movement prediction model based on adversarial training. Specifically, this research employs Fast Gradient Method (FGM) algorithm during the training process, which can effectively avoid overfitting, deal with stochasticity, and thus improve the model performance in generalization and accuracy. The finally reported experimental results on a tweet text dataset and a historical price dataset demonstrate that our method outperforms baseline models and achieves competitive performance compared with some current advances.

articleTitle: Exploiting Named Entity Recognition via Pre-trained Language Model and Adversarial Training
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Named Entity Recognition (NER) is a typical sequence labeling problem as a foundation of text information processing, which has gradually played a key role in the technology of natural language processing (NLP). Also, it is widely applied to handle enormous sub-tasks of NLP. The current methods mainly use BERT and other powerful deep learning components to extract the semantic information of sentences from complex texts. Then, they perform sequence labeling to identify entity information. However, such methods usually encounter the problem of overfitting. Moreover, those methods always show poor performance in generalization ability and robustness. Compared with such methods, to extract effective entities, we propose a named entity recognition model based on adversarial training. For the encoding layer, we present Bidirectional Encoder Representations From Transformers (BERT) as the pre-trained language model to get the word vector to enrich the semantic representation. After combining the word vector obtained by BERT and the word vector obtained by the glove, we investigate a method of Bi-LSTM in the feature extraction layer for training to adapt to the disturbance and recognize the named entity. Our core innovation is introducing the Fast Gradient Method (FGM) to generate adversarial examples for the adversarial attack. The adversarial attack would add disturbance data to the encoding layer. In this way, we successfully strengthen the abilities of both generalization and robustness, thereby improving the model's performance. We conduct experiments on widely used NER datasets on Chinese Resume NER for the model we proposed. Additionally, the experimental results show that our model has achieved some comparable results on recognizing named entities. The Precision rate, Recall rate, and F1 score obtained are respectively 0.9541,0.9538,0.9536.

articleTitle: Android Application for Automatic Pneumonia Recognition Based on CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Convid-19, which is a severe form of pneumonia, swept the globe in recent years. How to use AI technology to help identify pneumonia is the focus of many studies now. This paper proposed an Android application based on CNN model to help patients identify the relevant information of pneumonia, determining whether the type of pneumonia is a virus, bacteria or normal. CNN model was introduced with different parameter configurations to train to get the optimal results. In the process of training the model, Adam optimizer and cross-entropy loss function were used, and the confusion matrix expressed the results. To provide the best service for non-professional users(patients), we chose the android application as an interface, the application consists of two main sections, including the image uploading section and consulting section. Image uploading section, who transfer the image to be diagnosed, which received using the camera or accessing to the SD card, to our server computer. Consulting section, the patient can upload their questions about their diagnosis results, descriptions of the symptoms, any preliminary proposals. The answer comes from a professionally recognized medical website or a Q&A library established by the medical institution itself. Extensive experiments demonstrated the proposed method could identify pneumonia automatically with high performance than other methods.

articleTitle: Colorization of Anime Gray Images via Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In the process of human cognition to the world, coloring plays a decisive role, so gray image coloring is a key topic in the field of digital image processing, has great research significance. More and more deep learning-based coloring methods have been proposed with the development of deep learning and the rapid update and iteration of current large-scale computing devices. The coloring effect is getting better and better. In this context, this paper adopts the gray image shading algorithm based on Generative Adversarial Network (GAN), uses U-Net as the compiler, LeNet as the decoder, and adds non-local blocks after using the convolutional layer of activation function in the first layer of the encoder to extract global features in a better way. At the same time, the color test is carried out on some animation grayscale images. The experimental results show that the method presented in this paper has a good dyeing effect.

articleTitle: Denoising for Intracranial Hemorrhage Images Using Autoencoder Based on CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Intracranial Hemorrhage, known as ICH, is a serious malady and is a major cause of stroke, disability, and death. Due to the malignant impact it would cause, it is essential to diagnose ICH in an efficient way. Meanwhile, the prevalence of artificial intelligence has caught people's attention and we considered that the diagnosis of ICH could be improved with the help of machine learning methods since these methods have succeeded in realms like speech recognition, visual object recognition, object detection etc. There have already been some computer aided diagnosis systems, based on machine learning methods, for helping the diagnosis of ICH, but most of them were used to classify the images and people seem to have ignored the importance of the quality of images. In this study, we applied a denoising method based on CNNs to improve the quality of ICH images based on CT. LeNet-5 and AlexNet were used due to their mighty ability to extract features. Autoencoder was used to reduce the dimensionality of the datasets to reduce the complexity of the data. Before denoising, we did some preprocessing in order to make our training faster by setting all images into a specific format. To test our model, three kinds of noise were added to the images, which were Salt&Pepper, Poisson and Gaussian. Lastly, we used Euclidean distance, which is the D-value of the pixel value between the original images and the processed ones, to measure the results of denoising images and determine their similarity to the original images. And the smaller the value, the better the effect. The results turned out that our denoising model is effective for all three kinds of noise, and the result of Salt&Pepper noise is the best.

articleTitle: Analysis of Wetten Antenna Based on Deep Learning Radio Translation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In nature, the antenna is placed in some places that not to touch, which makes the wet condition of the antenna unknown, and in turn, when calculating the wet antenna attenuation, a certain error is generated, and this paper proposes a method of using a depth learning network. A analysis of the wet condition of the antenna is used to calculate the decay of wet antenna, which in turn exactly calculates the radio link attenuation, and uses attenuation to extrapolation the medium in the radio propagation.

articleTitle: Forecasting the load flow of Engine Driven Pump based on Light Gradient Boosting Machine Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The flow rate of aircraft hydraulic system is one of the important parameters to measure the performance of aircraft. The stability of flow rate of hydraulic pipeline is related to the safety of hydraulic system and even aircraft flight. Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to measure the load flow of aircraft hydraulic system, a prediction method based on ensemble learning for the load flow of Engine Driven Pump (EDP) is proposed. According to the different working conditions of EDP, the Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) model is established. Through Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm optimizes the super parameters of LightGBM algorithm, and realizes the regression prediction mode. Finally, compared with the multiple linear regression, random forest, experimental results indicate that the proposed model obviously can improve the prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of assembled emergency medical system based on BIM+
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: “BIM+” is to complete different tasks through the combination of BIM (building information modeling) system and various technologies (Internet, big data, etc.). It is a production mode that digitizes the whole product life cycle and manufacturing process and integrates the modularization based on information and communication technology to form highly flexible, personalized and digital products and services. This paper introduces the combination of BIM system and prefabricated construction, analyzes the shortcomings of the existing medical system in emergency situations, summarizes the future improvement direction of medical buildings, and the advantages of the temporary medical cabin formed by the combination of BIM system and prefabricated construction, hoping to provide reference for promoting the development of buildings in China under the emergency medical system.

articleTitle: An Improved Multi-Source Data Fusion Method Based on a New Divergence Measure
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Nowadays, due to its efficiency in processing conflict and uncertainty information, multi-sensor data fusion method has received extensive attention in practical applications. Dempster-Shafer evidence theory (DSET) plays a vital role in solving complex and imprecise information problems. However, when dealing with highly conflicting evidence, DSET will produce an unreasonable result between distinct basic probability assignments (BPAs). Recent researches indicate that divergence measure is a valid method with similarity degree and information volume to confirm the weight of evidence. As a result, how to solve the counterintuitive result with the weight model has become an open question. In this article, an improved multi-source data fusion method model with a novel divergence measure was proposed. Within the framework of DSET, the proposed divergence measure method has been demonstrated to satisfy various expected characteristics of divergence measure. In addition, we combine the proposed fusion model and the divergence measure to preprocess the data to obtain the final weights. Compared with the existing experimental results, the proposed fusion model outperforms other correlation models, giving the highest belief value 99.38% to the right target.

articleTitle: Frequency Reconfigurable Microstrip Bandpass Filter Based on VO2
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Reconfigurability is very popular in advanced highly integrated wireless communication circuits and systems, which is valuable for mitigating spectrum congestion and reducing signal interference. To reduce interference and meet the different wireless standards in different countries, frequency reconfigurable filters are promising. Concurrently, due to the conductor and semiconductor properties of VO2 at different temperatures or pressures, the phase transition characteristics of new material VO2 are applied to reconfigurable filters. This paper mainly discusses the application of phase transition characteristics of VO2 materials in filter design and proposes a frequency reconfigurable microstrip bandpass filter based on VO2 materials, in which the microstrip filter adopts the design form of end coupling. Through theoretical calculation, data analysis, and the establishment of the equivalent model of VO2 phase transition, a related design is proposed. An end-coupled microband bandpass filter centered at a reconfigurable frequency (6 GHz to 6.5 GHz) with fractional bandwidth of 2.8% has been designed, which shows consistent match with the expected ones and verify the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Algorithm Of Ddistribution Nnetwork Ttopology Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Combined with the practical engineering problems of distribution automation, it is proposed to take the feeder section as a graph, take each node in the section as the vertex of the graph, take the line segment between nodes as the arc of the graph, and take the direction of line power flow as the direction of the arc. Therefore, the mathematical model of feeder section of distribution network is established. Based on this model, the network-based structure matrix and directed description matrix of interval are defined and further structured. Thus, the data structure and calculation analysis method can be closely combined with the topology analysis function of GIS platform. Finally, the calculation process of network loss based on this method is described, and the processing of incomplete measurement data is discussed.

articleTitle: Research on waveform characteristics of capacitor switched for disturbance detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Transient caused by capacitor switched has been widely used in power quality analysis, capacitor running state detection, and load modeling due to containing much related information of power system and capacitors. The premise of this study is to detect transient waveform for capacitor switched, so it is important for accuracy of the typical characteristics. Current typical characteristics of the transient disturbance for capacitor switched are based on the same period switching in the three phases, however, the three-phase capacitor is difficult to complete exactly same period switched in reality. In this paper, the transient current at the substation monitoring points is analyzed for neutral grounded and neutral ungrounded systems and synchronously and asynchronously switched. Through the establishment of the typical characteristics, the differences of transient current characteristics between switched synchronously and asynchronously are indicated obviously, so as to provide accurate foundation for detection of three-phase capacitor switched transient and development of following relevant analysis. In this paper, theoretical analysis, simulation results verify the accuracy of the established transient disturbance characteristics.

articleTitle: Tow matching localization algorithm for short fiber bunched tow based on global-local images
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In a system that detects tension in polyester fibers on a circuit, If the tension of the tow is to be detected, the position of the tow must be precisely located. this paper proposes a matching localization algorithm for short fiber bunches based on global-local dual images to achieve the precise positioning of polyester fiber tow. This algorithm mainly uses the characteristic difference of the polyester filament beam to match the same polyester fiber tow in the local and global filament beam images. Furthermore, the positioning of the polyester fiber tow to be tested for tension in the local polyester fiber image is realized in the global polyester fiber tow image. The algorithm has good real-time performance and high accuracy.

articleTitle: A software upgrade security analysis method based on program analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Security of online software upgrade has become one of the most important evaluation criteria of cyber security. It is too inefficient to evaluate the security of software upgrade by manual reverse analysis method, which requires high-level cryptography knowledge and reverse analysis ability of researchers. The universality of software upgrade vulnerability puts forward high requirements for efficient and automatic analysis methods. In this paper, we propose a program analysis method combining dynamic analysis and static analysis to automatically evaluate software upgrade security. By parsing the process of software online upgrade deeply, we establish the upgrade vulnerability models, and utilize the program analysis method to evaluate the upgrade security. The experimental result has shown that this method can evaluate the security of software upgrade accurately and quickly.

articleTitle: Application of Xgboost algorithm in Prediction of Students Grades Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Now, people have gradually realized the importance of education with the continuous improvement of their quality of life. In the current teaching management system, students' grade is still an important reference for evaluating the quality of teaching. At the same time, there are many factors that will affect the students' performance in exams, such as the education of students' parents, students' usual performance and so on. Using data mining, machine learning and other methods to analyze and predict the performance in exams using the relevant data of students' examination results is of great significance for correcting students' bad behavior or testing professional skills of teachers. In this paper, a new algorithm is proposed, which combines XGBoost algorithm with grid search algorithm and cross validation to predict students' math, writing and reading scores. Compared with the traditional decision tree and random forest algorithm, it showed that XGBoost algorithm can evidently reduce the RSME of prediction results.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation Algorithm of Power Communication Network Service Function Chain based on Resource Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low utilization rate of the underlying network resources during the resource allocation of the service function chain, this paper proposes a resource allocation algorithm for the power communication network service function chain based on resource characteristics. The algorithm includes: network initialization, calculating the relative cost of the underlying nodes and the underlying links, constructing a logical function diagram for the service function chain request, and assigning the shortest and least costly underlying path for each link requested by the service function chain. In the step of calculating the relative cost of the underlying node and the underlying link, by calculating the relative cost value for all nodes and links, the load balance of the underlying network resources during resource allocation is realized. In order to improve the utilization of the underlying link resources, a logical function diagram construction mechanism is proposed to allocate the shortest and least costly underlying path for each link requested by the service function chain. In the performance analysis part, from the two dimensions of the availability rate of the underlying network resources and the success rate of the resource allocation of the service function chain, the algorithm in this paper is compared with the existing research, and it is verified that the algorithm in this paper has improved the utilization rate of the underlying network resources and services. The distribution success rate of the functional chain.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Technology of Opening and Closing Process of High Voltage Isolating Switch in Normal and Fault State
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The high-voltage isolating switch is an important switching device in the electrical system of power plants and substations. This article takes the GW23B-252 isolating switch as an example, and conducts dynamic simulation on it. This paper Obtains the relationship between the output shaft torque and rotation angle of the operating mechanism with time by simulating the closing and opening process of the main knife under normal operating conditions. Which provides a reference basis for the installation, commissioning, overhaul and maintenance of the isolation switch, and provides guidance for fault diagnosis and product maintenance.

articleTitle: Siamese Region Proposal Tracker with Feature Pyramid Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Visual object tracking is a fundamental task in computer vision, and numerous tracking algorithms are proposed to improve both accuracy and robustness. However, recent trackers often adopt the feature from the last layer to track the target, which ignores the detailed information from the shallow layers. This paper aims to aggregate both shallow and deep features to improve the tracker's performance. Inspired by Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) in object tracking, we add a bottom-up pathway in the Siamese-RPN to obtain a more representative performance. We test our method on OTB-100, and we obtain an overall 0.617 maximum success rate. The experimental results show the strength of the shallow feature to improve the tracking accuracy.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Approach for Learning Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The feedback of students' satisfaction of learning is one of the important contents of the evaluation and management of higher education. The application of satisfaction originated from the Western business field, and later was used in education and educational activities. Students' learning satisfaction can directly reflect students' satisfaction to colleges and universities. After college education, students can evaluate their feelings by subjective cognition, which is of great reference value to college administrators and teachers. As learning satisfaction is affected by multiple factors such as individual students and school, the analysis of learning satisfaction data is also a part of judging the quality of college curriculum. In this study, the questionnaire of learning satisfaction is distributed to students through the network and then collected. The dataset is analyzed through decision tree. Furthermore, the parameters for above approach are adjusted by artificial bee colony. The proposed intelligent approach has the best accuracy among compared approaches.

articleTitle: Realization of Digital Balance Algorithm Based on HLS for High Precision Impedance Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Aiming to improve the accuracy and calculation speed of high precision impedance analyzer efficiently, we developed a digital balance algorithm module of the impedance analyzer based on High-Level Synthesis (HLS). The function of the proposed algorithm is realized by parabolic interpolation method with a faster convergence speed than the previous ternary search method. Then the digital balance algorithm based on C language is converted into a hardware algorithm accelerator based on Hardware Description Language (HDL) through HLS. After generating the IP core of the digital balance algorithm module and constructing the whole hardware system, we tested the properties of the design by measuring several electronic components respectively, where the digital balance algorithm is based on different methods. Through observing the waveform of the bridge balance point, we conclude that the amplitude of the balance point after digital balance adjustment is below 16mV with a shorter balance time about 450ms, which verify the reliability and the optimization of the implementation of the proposed algorithm by HLS.

articleTitle: A quantification method for power communication optical cable service carrying capacity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Carrying out the research on the service carrying capacity of power communication optical cables is helpful to distinguish the load level of optical cables, and is of great significance to the maintenance of heavy-load optical cables and the optimization of communication networks. First, based on the actual power communication network, the characteristics of services and optical cables are analyzed, and the main factors that will affect the load are clarified; then, according to the main influencing factors, two indexes of service dependency and fiber optic cable reliability are defined, and the load quantification method is given; finally, through comparison with other load quantification methods, the feasibility and applicability of the proposed method are proved. The research conclusions have certain guiding significance for the load balancing, network optimization, and heavy load identification of the power communication network.

articleTitle: Control Application Based on Multi-objective Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The application of drones is a recent hot research topic. We need to use drones based on some optimization algorithms to find the best path for simulation data. We will use Monte Carol to simulate the initial solution to establish a multiobjective simulated annealing algorithm to arrange the UAV and balance two main goals: safety and cost. We also use other factors as parameters, including the size and frequency of the destination. We applied the algorithm to the simulated data and got the solution result. In addition, we conducted a sensitivity analysis on the outer loop parameters of the simulated annealing algorithm. At the same time, the model was evaluated, and its development prospects were forecasted.

articleTitle: Shopee Price Match Guarantee Algorithm based on multimodal learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Shopee has been a popular online shopping website in the Southeast Asia. Customers appreciate its easy, secure, and fast online shopping experience tailored to their region. At the same time, it allows customers to choose the one with the lower price of the same product. It relies on the product matching, that is the same product with the same description image must be removed. The base technology to achieve this function is multimodal learning, in which we focus on the images and text. In our article, we proposed a new multimodal learning model mainly based on transformer and BERT. For image matching, we use NFNet, Swin_Transformer and Efficientnet to get image embeddings. For text matching, we use Distil-Bert, Albert, Multilingual Bert and TF-IDF to get text embeddings. After we get the embedding vector, we choose KNN to classify. We use cosine and distance to measure the similarity of the different models. It is worth mentioning that the loss function is Arcface, not the traditional Softmax, which improve the difficulty of training to ensure the final performance in the test periods. In addition, 7 models vote for the final results ensuring the effect of prediction. To avoid the bad matching result, we add some postprocessing process.

articleTitle: Improved Interference Cancellation Method in FBMC/OQAM system on PAPR reduction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In the filter bank multicarrier with offset quadrature amplitude modulation (FBMC/OQAM) system, the Interference Cancellation Method (ICM) is an effective channel estimation method. However, the system's excessively high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) will cause signal distortion and affect the channel estimation performance when passing through the power amplifier at the transmitting end. Aiming to reduce the high PAPR of the system, the improved Interference Cancellation Method with phase rotation (I-ICM) is proposed. I-ICM generates different phase sequences, which are multiplied with transmission data to obtain different Data sequences and calculate its PAPR, respectively, and then select the group with the lowest PAPR for transmission. It is verified by simulation that I-ICM can reduce the high PAPR of the system, the bit error rate (BER) is reduced, and the channel estimation performance is not significantly lower compared with ICM.

articleTitle: A Medical Support Application for Public based on Convolutional neural network to Detect Skin Cancer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Health problem, as the most currently wide social consensus, has attracted great attention in the medical domain and academic community. Especially most current females, they concern about their skin problems even more than average people. On the one hand, however, people may unconsciously ignore their skin problems since the peace of their work and life is getting faster and faster today. On the other hand, it is still hard for people to take time out to do a series of professional tests to discover the potential skin problems by going to hospitals even though they can notice the uncomfortable feeling in touching or the unnormal color surface of the skin. To alleviate the worry of people's skin problems effectively and warn them of the problems in time, we designed a medical support application for the public and community based on Convolutional Neural Network to detect common skin cancers in general. In this application, we trained a convolutional neural network that can effectively extract the medical knowledge that it can analyze whether the inputs, as known as skin images or non-skin images at first. The technology should analyze which kinds of skin problems from the skin images father. In addition, this application provides two extra supported functions, including the chat room and the personal center. A user can ask questions via the chat room that there is an AI assistant who would respond to the questions properly. It is also available for the user to contact a real doctor by typing the specific content. What's more, the personal center allows logged-in users to browse the history of tests and take feedback for the certain test based on the professional result of the skin problem.

articleTitle: Design of Dynamic Testing Device for Watertight Opto-electrical Rotary Joint
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: A new design scheme of photo-electrical rotary joint dynamic detection device is proposed, which can simulate the actual working state of photo-electrical rotary joint and dynamically detect its photo-electrical performance at its actual working speed. According to the scheme, a kind of watertight photo-electrical rotary joint detection device is designed. The optical signal insertion loss, contact resistance, life of the watertight opto-electrical rotary joint and other parameters can be tested under variable rotation speed and high voltage.

articleTitle: Calibration of Hyperparameters for Pedestrian Flow Model Based on Bayesian Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The study of pedestrian flow has attracted considerable interest in the last three decades. Simulation of pedestrian flow provides a convenient approach for researchers to take insights into the dynamics of pedestrian crowd under various situations. The results of simulation can be helpful in emergency predicting and avoiding crowd disasters. In this study, a well-known pedestrian behavior dynamic model, the social force model, is investigated. Bayesian optimization is applied to calibrate the hyperparameters of the model by minimizing the difference of the fundamental diagrams between simulation results and empirical data given in literature. With the hyperparameters calculated by Bayesian optimization, the fundamental diagram of pedestrian flow is nearly the same as the empirical result under various densities.

articleTitle: An efficient iterative algorithm for moving target positioning in distributed MIMO radars
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper proposes an efficient iterative algorithm for determining the position and velocity of a moving target in di stributed MIMO radar systems. We first formulate the localizatio n problem as a constrained weighted least squares (CWLS) probl em, which is essentially a quadratically constrained quadratic pro gramming (QCQP) problem due to its quadratic equality constrai nts. Then, the QCQP problem is transformed into a linearly const rained quadratic programming (LCQP) problem through approx imating each non-convex constraint as a linear constraint, and it i s solved iteratively based on QR decomposition. The closed-form solution in each iteration for solving the LQCP problem makes th e proposed method have high computational efficiency. The perfo rmance of the proposed method is validated via numerical simulations.

articleTitle: A New Blind Evaluation Method of Infrared Image Quality
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Blind evaluation of digital image quality has always been one of the most challenging problems in artificial intelligence and computer vision. Because of the limitation of imaging mechanism, the overall quality of infrared reconnaissance image is lower than that of visible image. It will seriously restrict the efficiency of subsequent image processing, seriously affect the performance of detection efficiency. The contours, textures and point features that can represent the characteristics of infrared radiation are analyzed and extracted, and a simple infrared image quality evaluation model combining mixed features and target saliency is constructed. Taking real infrared images as samples and subjective evaluation as the benchmark, the relative comparative verification is carried out. The results show that this method can achieve better evaluation performance than state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of Intelligent Service Platform for Flexible Employment in Internet Sharing Economy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the development of emerging technologies on the Internet, the dividends brought by the sharing economy are constantly undergoing butterfly change effect, and a new sharing mode-flexible employment arises at the historic moment. In order to solve the pain points of enterprises, freelancers and the government in the process of developing flexible employment in the sharing economy, this paper uses advanced technologies such as cloud computing, blockchain, artificial intelligence, big data and finance technology to research and develop the intelligent service platform for flexible employment in the sharing economy, one-stop SaaS (software as a service)platform for flexible employment and salary settlement based on sharing economy, one-stop completion of flexible employment, salary settlement, batch payment, invoice provision and legal tax payment, and provision of SaaS platform services for flexible employment and salary settlement based on sharing economy for enterprises. This platform research includes four sub platforms: shared employment SaaS platform; salary Settlement SaaS Platform; freelancer entrepreneurship and innovation services SaaS platform; big data collaborative supervision platform. The research results have been successfully transformed and put into operation to solve the pain points for enterprises, freelancers and government supervision. The platform has now served more than 100 enterprises, and nearly 5,000 freelancers who have realized innovation and entrepreneurship in the shared economy, and helped the government increase more tax revenue than traditional model. Finally, Example shows that compared with the traditional employment model, the platform in this paper achieves better performance, which helped enterprises reduce cost by 21.9%, while personal income increased by 12.3%, achieved good economic and social benefits.

articleTitle: The Development and Model Comparison For Entity Relation Extraction Task
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Relation extraction is a popular topic in natural language processing. This survey will introduce several major relation extraction methods, from feature and kernel-based to neural networks. We will discuss the basic idea and the performance of these methods and hope that this article will give readers a general concept of relation extraction.

articleTitle: Research on multi-product artificial intelligence recommendation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the rise of diversified stores, the relationship between consumer characteristics and commodities affects consumer orientation. Stores are in urgent need of the application of artificial intelligence, the ultimate purpose of which is to help diversified products make accurate consumption recommendations. 565 questionnaire survey data of a cultural and creative store in Fuzhou, China, this paper uses the Apriori association rule algorithm to find out the consumption relevance between goods, and then uses the C5.0 classification algorithm to set consumers' purchase decision-making behavior as the target variable, and three characteristic factors affecting consumers' basic attributes, behavior characteristics and purchase preferences as independent variables. The results showed that coffee beans (10%) were a boost to drinks (85%), tea (10%) to art tea sets (84%), wood carvers (32%) to home furnishings (84%), plants (10%) to incense burrs (80%), and toys (26%) to stationery (78%).

articleTitle: Design of Hybrid Architecture Cloud Center of Service-Oriented Aerospace T&C Application Integration System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In view of the deficiencies in the current situation of various types of system centers in the field of aerospace measurement, transportation and control, especially the in-depth analysis and summary of the inadaptability of the existing system architecture, combined with the actual needs of my country's satellite applications in the development of industrialization, ubiquity and democratization, this article puts forward the design idea of a service-oriented hybrid architecture integrated measurement, operation and control cloud center. By building a cloud platform and a distributed service-oriented software architecture, use a hybrid software interaction model of “centralization” and “decentralization”, adopt service-oriented and hybrid architecture software systems and other technologies, The parallel task execution capabilities and resource scheduling and management capabilities of the Aerospace T&C System Center are improved, so as to improve the timeliness and accuracy of the system response to meet the actual needs of a large number of users for real-time service response. It has certain guiding and reference significance for the follow-up construction of related aerospace measurement and control centers.

articleTitle: Vehicle Trajectory Prediction with Goal Estimation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Vehicle trajectory prediction with multiple highly interactive agents plays a critical role for autonomous driving applications, especially in some crowded and challenging scenarios such as intersections and roundabouts. There are many internal and external factors that influence the behavior of the interactive agents.
